Sketch Injection Three Ways

All arms on the real-only checkpoints: the pin (gate_pin_joint_realonly) for ours; pi0 fine-tuned on the same 100 real demos (gate_scratch_real) for SDEdit and for the sketch command written into the source with the flow's velocity projected off the command subspace by a fraction (1 - s) at every Euler step: s = 0 carries the command exactly, s = 1 is naive injection. Same sketches, same simulator, 5 trials each.
